messages.content:
Summarize in one sentence of at most 200 characters:

The city council voted 7-2 on Tuesday to approve a $12 million budget for repairing the Riverside Bridge. Work begins in April and is expected to last eight months, during which one lane will remain open.

reference: Council approved $12 million to repair the Riverside Bridge, starting April for eight months with one lane open.

Summarize in at most 180 characters:

Q3 revenue rose 14% to $82M, driven by the Pro plan. Churn fell to 2.1%. The company hired 30 engineers and plans to open a Lisbon office in Q1.

reference: Q3 revenue grew 14% to $82M as churn fell to 2.1%; a Lisbon office is planned for Q1.
